Name: OmniMedVQA
Description: OmniMedVQA: large-scale comprehensive evaluation benchmark for medical LVLMs (multi-modality VQA)
Notes: Download (HuggingFace): pip install datasets; python -c from datasets import load_dataset; ds = load_dataset('foreverbeliever/OmniMedVQA'); ds.save_to_disk('OmniMedVQA')". OpenDataLab page: https://openxlab.org.cn/datasets/GMAI/OmniMedVQA — follow their download instructions (may use Google Drive / Baidu links). License: check the HuggingFace dataset card and OpenDataLab page before reuse; some image sources may have additional restrictions."

Name: MultiMedQA
Description: MultiMedQA: aggregated benchmark of medical question-answering datasets for LLM evaluation
Notes: Download: MultiMedQA is an aggregator — follow the PapersWithCode page to obtain each component dataset (each sub-dataset has its own download URL). Typical workflow: visit the PW page, click component dataset links, download per-dataset files. License: check each component dataset's license individually.

Name: MedQA
Stars: Download: consult PapersWithCode or the original paper links; many implementations provide scripts (e.g., git clone <impl-repo> && bash scripts/download.sh). License: depends on original source — verify before redistribution.

Name: MedMCQA
Notes: Download: git clone https://github.com/medmcqa/medmcqa.git; cd medmcqa; read README for data links. If authors provide direct archives, use wget <archive_url> -O medmcqa.zip && unzip medmcqa.zip -d data/. License: MIT (see repository LICENSE).

Name: PubMedQA
Description: PubMedQA: biomedical QA dataset from PubMed abstracts
Notes: Download: git clone https://github.com/pubmedqa/pubmedqa.git; data files are included in the repo (see 'data' or README). Alternatively check the project website https://pubmedqa.github.io. License: MIT per repo — still verify README for any third-party constraints.

Name: MedMCQ
Stars: Download: follow the PapersWithCode dataset page to the original source(s). License: check the original dataset(s) listed on the PW page.

Name: HEAD-QA
Description: HEAD-QA: healthcare QA dataset for complex reasoning
Notes: Download: project page https://aghie.github.io/head-qa/ contains dataset download links (often .tar.gz or .zip). Example: wget <link_to_headqa_archive> -O headqa.tar.gz && tar -xzf headqa.tar.gz -C data/headqa. License: MIT (check repo LICENSE).

Name: MIRIAD
Description: MIRIAD: million-scale Medical Instruction and Retrieval Dataset
Notes: Download: git clone https://github.com/eth-medical-ai-lab/MIRIAD.git; follow README for HuggingFace link or download scripts. If available on HuggingFace: python -c from datasets import load_dataset; ds = load_dataset('eth-medical-ai-lab/MIRIAD')". License: check repository README and dataset card for license and use restrictions."

Name: MedQA-Relabeled
Notes: Download: git clone https://github.com/Google-Health/med-gemini-medqa-relabelling.git; annotation files typically live in a folder like 'annotations' or 'data' — check README. Direct raw file URL example: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Google-Health/med-gemini-medqa-relabelling/main/<path_to_file>. License: Apache-2.0 (see repo LICENSE).
